attempted_claim: Let F be a field of characteristic p != 2. Prove that for every finite A subset of F* with |A| << p^{1/2} if p > 0 (no condition if p = 0), |A(A+1)| >>~ |A|^{5/4}, where >>~ hides absolute constants and powers of log|A|, and A(A+1) = {a(b+1) : a,b in A}.
decisive_failure: The negative outcome is method-boundedness, not disproof: the target may still be true and provable by a future sharp incidence breakthrough, and this lane did not exhaust all of mathematics, only all bounded routes available in the pass. No computation rules out the 5/4 exponent.
